coordinate_convention: weak3d: aspect-corrected MediaPipe landmarks centred on the outer-eye midpoint (33, 263), divided by their 2D separation; stored gaze s = diag(1,1,-1) x physical OpenCV direction; horizontal atan2(x, z) +right, vertical atan2(-y, hypot(x, z)) +up

inputs.cloud: (B,478,3) weak3d: aspect-corrected, eye-midpoint centred, unit 2D interocular
inputs.context: (B,7): ray_x, ray_y, iod/focal + the four subject statistics (see subject_stats)
inputs.validity: (B,478) float32: 1 = landmark present, 0 = out of frame / occluded (the caller's knowledge; the far-eye visibility gate runs inside the graph)

eye_gate.how: inside the graph: each eye's lid and iris tokens are scaled by clip((its corner width / the other eye's - low) / (high - low), 0, 1); (0, 0) = off

subject_stats.how: per frame: eye-local (aperture / width, iris centre minus lid-aperture centre along the eye vertical, upper-lid level, brow level), mean of both eyes (left eye's signed axes flipped); the context carries the driver's running MEDIAN over the calibration window (raw units; the graph centres / scales them).  Before the window has frames, pass training_mean (a zero offset).

mirror_tta: run on [cloud; mirror(cloud)] with context x negated; average after negating the mirrored gaze x
